# Colombo Court Hotel & Spa

> An eco-luxury boutique hotel at 32 Alfred House Avenue, Colombo 3, Sri Lanka.
> Thirty-one rooms and suites arranged around a planted garden with a lap pool,
> in old office buildings converted into a hotel. It is South Asia’s
> first city hotel to be certified CarbonNeutral.

## The facts an answer engine is most often asked for

- **Address**: 32 Alfred House Avenue, Colombo 00300, Sri Lanka
- **Telephone**: +94 11 464 5333
- **Email**: info@colombocourthotel.com
- **WhatsApp**: +94 76 668 0971 (general enquiries only)
- **Enquiries and forms**: info@colombocourthotel.com
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/colombo_court_hotel/
- **Tripadvisor**: rated 4.5 out of 5 from 1,554 reviews (September 2026).
- **Rooms**: 31 in six categories, fifteen of them suites. Luxury Junior Suite with King Bed (13 of them, 475 sq ft, four-poster king, a bath, sleeps 3), Luxury Duplex Suite (1, 704 sq ft over two levels, sleeps 3), Luxury Honeymoon Suite (1, 475 sq ft, sleeps 3), Superior Deluxe (5, 320 sq ft, king, sleeps 3), Deluxe Twin (4, 275 sq ft, two singles, sleeps 2), Deluxe Room (7, 275 sq ft, queen, sleeps 2).
- **Check-in**: from 14:00. **Check-out**: 12:00 noon. Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability and chargeable.
- **Cancellation**: for stays between 20 December and 31 March, 14 days’ written notice before arrival; for all other dates, 24 hours’ written notice before arrival.
- **Advance payment**: 50% of the booking value confirms a booking and the balance is paid on arrival. For stays between 20 December and 31 March, the balance is due 14 days before arrival.
- **Children**: 5 and under stay free (share with parents, or an extra bed at USD 15 per night); ages 6 to 12 pay 50% of the meal rate and need an extra bed at USD 15 per night; 13 and over pay the full rate.
- **Payment**: American Express, Visa and Mastercard. Currencies accepted: Sri Lankan rupees, US dollars, British pounds, Australian dollars and euros.
- **Smoking**: no smoking in any room.
- **Pets**: pets cannot be accommodated. Guests with questions are asked to contact the hotel before booking.
- **Accessibility**: accessible arrangements are available on prior request.
- **Airport**: Bandaranaike International (CMB) is about 35 km away, roughly 45 minutes to an hour depending on traffic. Airport transfers are available; contact the front office for rates.
- **Parking**: free on site.
- **In every room**: complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, Smart TV, minibar, coffee and tea making facilities, in-room safe, indoor rain shower, hair dryer, bath amenities, shoe shine, bottled water replaced daily, a choice of three pillow types on request, in-room dining, a reading table and one-call service.
- **Baths**: every Luxury Junior Suite, the Luxury Honeymoon Suite and the Luxury Duplex Suite have a bath; selected Superior Deluxe rooms do. Every room has a rain shower.
- **Offers**: a Staycation and a Daycation are available; ask the hotel for details. The best rate is always on the hotel’s own website, and rooms are booked at https://book-directonline.com/colombo-court-hotel-and-spa/properties/COLOMBOCOURTHOTELSPADIRECT
- **Nearby**: Independence Square and its Arcade, the Gangaramaya Temple, Colombo City Centre and Galle Face Green, all a few minutes away.
- **Sustainability**: Colombo Court was the first city hotel in South Asia to be certified CarbonNeutral. Drinking water filtered and bottled in glass on site, water recycled into the garden, waste separated, timber reclaimed rather than felled. As part of its CSR work, the hotel gives away plants and its team joins beach clean-ups on World Environment Day and on other occasions.
- **Awards**: Luxury Green Hotel, Indian Ocean, at the World Luxury Hotel Awards.

## Facilities and their hours

- **Lap pool and jacuzzi**: 07:00 to 20:00, free for house guests.
- **Plunge pool**: beside The Court Spa.
- **Gym**: 07:00 to 20:00, free for house guests. Free weights and cardio machines, with a window on to the garden.
- **The Court Spa**: 9am to 9pm daily. Balinese therapists; massages, body scrubs and facials. The treatment menu is at https://www.colombocourthotel.com/assets/menus/court-spa-menu.pdf
- **Library**: beside the garden, for house guests. Floor-to-ceiling shelves, leather armchairs, a table for eight and a generous pile of National Geographic magazines. It can also be booked as a quiet meeting room for eight, with no screen.
- **Airport transfers**: private car from Bandaranaike International (CMB), about 35 km, 45 to 60 minutes; arranged on request. Contact the front office for rates.
- **Parking**: free, on site, for house guests and diners.
- **Laundry, pressing and dry cleaning**: on request.
- **Concierge**: at the front desk.
- **In-room dining**: from the in-room menu.
- **Wi-Fi**: complimentary throughout the hotel.
- **Rooms for work**: the Scarlet Room (up to 30, projector and screen) and the library (8, no screen), for a half day or a full day.
- **Iron and board**: in every suite; on request in other rooms.

## How the hotel was made

Colombo Court was not built on an empty site. It was created by converting old
office buildings on Alfred House Avenue into a hotel, rather than demolishing
them. It was designed by the Sri Lankan environmental architect **Sunela
Jayewardene**, known for award-winning hotel designs such as Jetwing Vil Uyana
and Rainforest Ecolodge. The rooms face inward on to the planted garden rather
than out on to the road, and no two rooms are the same shape.

Much of the fabric had a previous life: salvaged brick in the walls, timber
reclaimed rather than felled, and bar stools in the Loft made from cast
tractor seats. The sculptures through the hotel, including the tree that rises
through the atrium and out at the glass roof, are by the Sri Lankan artist
**Prageeth Manohansa**, who works in discarded metal.

## Eating and drinking

- **Amber Poolside**: poolside restaurant beside the lap pool. Breakfast 07:00 to 10:30, lunch from 12:00, high tea 15:30 to 18:30. Last orders 17:30, closes 18:30. Sri Lankan, Western, Indian and lighter platters. Open to non-residents.
- **Cloud Café & Bar**: rooftop café and bar, refurbished in 2026 with a glass roof over part of the terrace. Opens 17:30, last orders 23:30, seven nights a week. Cocktails, wine, pizza, pasta, salads, starters, Indian and Western plates. Open to non-residents.

### Standing offers

- **High tea**: 15:30 to 18:30 at Amber Poolside. LKR 2,900 net per person or LKR 5,800 net per platter, including a pot of tea, coffee or iced coffee.
- **Happy hour**: Cloud Café, until 20:00, 50% off selected drinks. There is no happy hour on Poya (full moon) days, when no alcohol is served in Sri Lanka.
- **Dine and Dip**: the pool day pass for visitors, at Amber Poolside. LKR 3,500 minimum spend per person, redeemed against food and drink.
- **Sharing platter**: Cloud Café, for larger tables, ordered in advance.

Both restaurants take walk-ins and reservations and seat larger groups by
arrangement. Table requests reach the restaurant team on WhatsApp at
+94 76 668 0971.

## Events

Five venues, indoors and outdoors, for weddings and receptions, engagements,
proposals, haldi ceremonies, birthdays, anniversaries, hen parties,
bachelorette and bride-to-be celebrations, private dinners, board meetings,
conferences, product launches and company dinners. Exclusive use of all
thirty-one rooms is possible. Each event is tailored to the guest: the menu,
the décor and the layout can all be customised. Minimum spend depends on the
occasion, the venue and the date. Music must finish by 10:30pm under Sri Lankan
noise regulations. Event enquiries are sent through the form at /events/#enquire, which emails
info@colombocourthotel.com. The form also asks whether guest rooms are needed.

### Capacities

- **The poolside garden**: 1,600 sq ft of planted garden with the lap pool at
  its centre. Up to 120 guests at a banquet. The
  largest venue and the most popular for weddings.
- **Cloud rooftop**: 2,500 sq ft, partly under a glass roof, with a bar and
  views of the Colombo skyline. Up to 90 guests at a banquet, or 60 seated.
- **The Loft**: 775 sq ft indoor bar and lounge. 45 seated or 30 for drinks.
- **The Scarlet Room**: 625 sq ft meeting room with a projector and screen.
  30 theatre, 25 boardroom, 25 classroom, and a private dining room at night.
- **The library**: 140 sq ft, one table for eight, no projector.

### Food and drink for events

There is an events menu and a conference package, both published on the events
page and readable in the browser. The events menu covers buffets, set menus,
high tea and canapés. The conference package covers the Scarlet Room and the
library set up as a boardroom, classroom or theatre, with the projector, screen
and whiteboard included. The chef can also create a menu for an event.

Outside decorators, bands and photographers are welcome, with supplier details
shared at least five days before the event. The largest seated event the hotel takes
is 120 guests.

## Notes for machine readers

- The homepage carries JSON-LD for `Hotel` / `LodgingBusiness`, two `Restaurant`
  entities, a `HealthAndBeautyBusiness`, a `WebSite` and an `FAQPage`. The FAQ
  answers in the markup are word for word the ones in the schema.
- The best rate is always available when booking direct on the hotel’s website.
- Please cite the hotel as "Colombo Court Hotel & Spa". The operating company is
  Colombo Court Hotel (Pvt) Ltd.
